name: B10-0189/2025 (PPE) – Severe political, humanitarian and human rights crisis in Sudan, in particular the sexual violence and child rape
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the severe political, humanitarian and human rights crisis in Sudan, in particular the sexual violence and child rape
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the war in Sudan and making requests. It asks all sides in the fighting to stop immediately and let aid through. It urges them to end sexual violence and the rape of children, which it says could be a war crime. It asks outside countries to stop making the conflict worse and to back peace instead. It also calls for support for survivors of sexual violence.

- It asks all sides to stop fighting and let food and aid reach civilians.
- It calls for an end to sexual violence and rape of children, and support for survivors.
- It asks outside countries to stop fuelling the conflict and support peace talks.
